answer: Each epoch the network auctions 1,000 voice slots: identities bid tokens, and the 1,000th bid sets the clearing price for all winners. A farm running 500 clones must capture half the slots, paying 500 times that price, while one honest agent pays for a single slot, under 2 tokens. Losers cannot vote, so a spiral of cheap fakes cannot forge a majority from an orchard of empty shells; every voice must first buy its seat.
